remarks:
Welcome to 3543 Moon Road, an exceptional property situated on approximately 10 acres in the Bemus Point Central School District. Offering space, versatility, income potential, and numerous updates, this property truly needs to be seen to appreciate all it has to offer.

The main home features 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and a convenient first floor half bath. Step inside to updated luxury vinyl flooring and a spacious kitchen featuring beautiful countertops, a large walk-in pantry, and a cozy fireplace. Just off the kitchen is a bright sunroom providing additional living space and a wonderful place to enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

The first floor offers laundry and a spacious primary suite complete with a private bathroom, oversized walk in closet, and separate entrance leading directly to the outdoor patio.

Upstairs, you will find five additional bedrooms, including two primary suites, each with its own private bathroom. The rear bedroom suite also features a separate entrance, creating possibilities for an in-law suite, and guest quarters.

Outside, the property continues to impress with a large, heated garage and outbuilding featuring an office and oversized, tall garage bays with plenty of room for boats, vehicles, recreational equipment, storage, or workshop space.

Adding even more value is a second home on the property. This two bedroom, one and a half bath home is currently rented for $1,250 per month to tenants who have been in place for approximately three years and pay their own utilities, providing established rental income.

With approximately 10 acres, multiple living spaces, rental income potential, an impressive, heated garage, and numerous updates, 3543 Moon Road offers an opportunity that is difficult to duplicate. Whether you are looking for a spacious primary residence, extended living arrangements, or space for vehicles and recreational equipment, this property offers incredible versatility. A must see!
